name: Gatorade BKK RUN 2026
short_description: Gatorade BKK RUN 2026 is on Sunday 27 December 2026 at the Thai Smile Bus headquarters on Charoen Nakhon in Bangkok, over 21.1 km and 10 km.
ai_summary: Gatorade BKK RUN 2026 is a road race on Sunday 27 December 2026, organised by Gatorade Thailand and based at the Thai Smile Bus headquarters (Charoen Nakhon depot) in Bangkok. It offers a 21.1 km half marathon and a 10 km race, plus an Overall Championship entry for fast half marathoners. Runners must be at least 16 years old.

core_facts.venue: Thai Smile Bus Headquarters, Charoen Nakhon depot

faqs.question: How much does Gatorade BKK RUN 2026 cost?
faqs.answer: Checkrace lists the 21.1 km at THB 1,300 and the 10 km at THB 1,100. The 21.1 km Overall Championship entry costs THB 1,500 and needs a half marathon under 1:25 for men or 1:45 for women from a certified race in the past 12 months. Championship runners start about 15 metres ahead of Block A but are not eligible for age-group awards.

faqs.question: Where is race pack collection for Gatorade BKK RUN?
faqs.answer: Race packs are collected on Saturday 26 December 2026 from 10am to 7pm at the Thai Smile Bus headquarters (Charoen Nakhon depot). A representative can collect a pack with a copy of the runner's ID and their own original ID.
